title: Employee count by department including empty ones
statementMd:
List every department with its employee count, including departments with none (count 0).

Expected columns: `name`, `employees`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Count a column from the employees side after a `LEFT JOIN`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT d.name, COUNT(e.id) AS employees FROM departments d LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.department_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id, d.name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.

expected.query: SELECT d.name, COUNT(e.id) AS employees FROM departments d LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.department_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id, d.name;
